visual.general_description: Scatter chart of nine black circular markers plotted against a categorical-looking day axis and a linear hCG axis, with no legend, title or data labels.
visual.detailed_description: White-background chart with light grey horizontal gridlines. The vertical axis title reads "hCG, mIU/mL" and prints tick labels 0, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000 and 7000. The horizontal axis title reads "MTX Administration  Day" and prints tick labels -5, -2, 1, 4, 7, 21, 33, 41 and 48. One solid black circular marker is shown above each of the nine day labels, with no connecting line, error bars, legend or numeric data labels. Qualitatively the markers rise across the first four day labels and then fall across the remaining five labels.

pixel_observations: Vertical axis title printed: "hCG, mIU/mL"; tick labels 0 to 7000 in steps of 1000.
Horizontal axis title printed: "MTX Administration  Day"; tick labels -5, -2, 1, 4, 7, 21, 33, 41, 48.
Nine black circular markers, one per horizontal tick label; no connecting line, legend, title or data labels are printed.
Qualitative shape: markers rise across the first four labels, then fall across the remaining five labels; no numeric values are printed for any marker.
